author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic design project collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer for an exhibition planned for early December at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, logotype, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, flags, other exhibition derivatives, and print prep. Timeline Oct–Dec 2026. Seeking exhibition/graphic design experience, hand-drawn Japanese warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
